questions.explanation:

2. D is the only son of E. C is the brother of H. B is female and has two children.

 

           

3. E and H were of the same gender.

The gender of three persons G, E and H is not known. This implies that E and H are female and G is   male as the number of male and female members is equal.

                    

 

4. Neither C nor H is married to E and B. 

Now B has to be married as either both or none of the parents are alive. B could be married to A or D or G.

When B is married to A

B cannot be married to A as then B will have only one child. So, this implies that C and H will be the children of B and B will be married to D. Also, relationships regarding C and H cannot not be determined.

B cannot be married to G as then there will be only two generations. as E could not be married to C and thus will  be married to E
                
So, D is married to B. So, the final family tree will be as follows.

A, B, D, and E are married whereas G is not.

Hence, G does not belong to the group.
